label: Standing tall
desc: standing straight, arms relaxed at the sides, whole body visible

label: Hand on hip
desc: standing with one hand on the hip, weight on one leg, the other foot forward

label: Walking
desc: mid stride walking toward the camera, arms swinging naturally

label: Hands in pockets
desc: standing relaxed with both hands in the trouser pockets

label: Leaning on a wall
desc: leaning sideways against a wall, ankles crossed, one shoulder touching it

label: Seated, legs crossed
desc: seated on a stool with one leg crossed over the other, hands on the knee

label: Arms crossed
desc: waist up, both arms crossed over the chest, facing the camera

label: Hand to chin
desc: waist up, one hand raised with fingers touching the chin, head tilted

label: Holding a cup
desc: waist up, holding a cup with both hands at chest height

label: Hands on hips
desc: waist up, both hands resting on the hips, elbows out

label: Seated, leaning in
desc: seated on a chair, leaning forward, forearms resting on the thighs

label: Looking back
desc: walking away from the camera and looking back over the shoulder toward the camera

label: Three-quarter turn
desc: standing turned three quarters to the side with the hands loosely clasped in front, looking at the camera

label: Seated on a step
desc: sitting on a low wooden block with elbows resting on the knees and hands loosely clasped, looking at the camera

label: Jacket over shoulder
desc: standing with a jacket hooked on one finger slung over the shoulder, the otthe hand in the pocket

label: Ankles crossed
desc: standing with the legs crossed at the ankles and the arms loosely folded, smiling

label: Hand in hair
desc: one hand running through the hair, looking slightly away from the camera

label: Adjusting lapels
desc: both hands adjusting the lapels of the blazer, looking at the camera

label: Laughing
desc: laughing naturally and looking off to the side, hands relaxed at the sides

label: Over the shoulder
desc: body turned away, looking back over the shoulder at the camera

label: Hands in coat pockets
desc: both hands in the coat pockets, relaxed shoulders, soft smile at the camera
